title: A pragmatic builder
paragraphs: Software Engineering student at Concordia, interning at Ericsson. I build distributed systems and the infrastructure around them — load testing, observability, CI/CD — plus the AI tooling that makes teams faster.

I like problems where the legacy is messier than the spec. Reverse-engineering an undocumented VCS. Merging per-worker histograms because averaged percentiles lie. Reimplementing LoRA from scratch because I wanted to check the paper's numbers myself.
